💰 Financial Literacy金融素养

Compound interest复利

One bank offers 4.5% compounded annually, another 4.4% compounded monthly. Which pays more on $8000 over 5 years? The answer is not obvious — and the formula settles it in two lines.一家银行年利率 4.5%、按年复利，另一家 4.4%、按月复利。8000 加元存 5 年，哪家给得多？答案并不显然——公式两行就能算清。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Compound interest复利
  1. A=P(1+nr​)nt: r as a decimal, n = periods per year, exponent nt.A=P(1+nr​)nt：r 用小数，n 是每年计息次数，指数是 nt。
  2. Per period i=nr​; periods =nt (monthly for 6 years = 72).每期利率 i=nr​；期数 =nt（按月 6 年＝72 期）。
  3. Rule of 72: doubling time ≈rate in %72​ years — an estimate only.72 法则：翻倍时间 ≈年利率（%）72​ 年——只是估算。
A=P(1+nr​)nt
P=(1+nr​)ntA​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Compound interest复利

Working backwards: how much to invest now倒推：现在要投入多少

The unknown is P, so you divide by the growth factor instead of multiplying.未知数是 P，要除以增长因子而不是乘。

  1. Growth factor: (1+nr​)nt增长因子：(1+nr​)nt
  2. P=(1+nr​)ntA​
  3. Sanity check: P<A always.合理性检查：P 一定小于 A。
Try试一试
How much must be invested now at 6% compounded semi-annually to have $15000 in 4 years?年利率 6%、每半年复利一次，现在要投入多少，4 年后才有 $15000？
Answer答案
P=1.03815000​≈$11841.14

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Compound interest复利
  • r=4 ✗ → r=0.04.r=4 ✗ → r=0.04。
  • Exponent t ✗ → nt: quarterly for 5 years is 20 periods.指数用 t ✗ → 用 nt：按季 5 年是 20 期。
🎯
Type it in one line with brackets and round only at the end: 5000(1+0.04/12)^(72).一行输入、带括号，最后才四舍五入：5000(1+0.04/12)^(72)。

💰 Financial Literacy金融素养

Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资

Put $200 a month into a TFSA from age 18 and you have over $31000 at 28 — about $7000 of it is interest you never deposited. The same math tells you what a car loan or mortgage really costs.从 18 岁起每月往 TFSA（免税储蓄账户）存 $200，到 28 岁就超过 $31000——其中约 $7000 是你没存过的利息。同一套数学也告诉你车贷、房贷真正要花多少。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资
  1. Saving with equal deposits → FV. Loan → amount borrowed is PV; solve for PMT.定期等额存款 → 求终值 FV。贷款 → 借款额是现值 PV，求每期还款 PMT。
  2. i = rate per PAYMENT period, n = number of payments (monthly, 5 years → n=60).i＝每个还款期的利率，n＝还款次数（按月 5 年 → n=60）。
  3. Interest = total paid − amount borrowed (or − total deposited).利息＝总付款 − 借款额（储蓄则 − 总存入）。
FV=PMT⋅i(1+i)n−1​
PV=PMT⋅i1−(1+i)−n​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资

Canadian mortgage: semi-annual compounding, monthly payments加拿大房贷：半年复利、按月还款

Compounding and payment periods differ, so r/12 is wrong — you need the equivalent monthly rate.计息期和还款期不同，r/12 是错的——要用等价月利率。

  1. Half-year rate: 20.04​=0.02半年利率：20.04​=0.02
  2. Equivalent monthly: i=(1.02)1/6−1≈0.0033059等价月利率：i=(1.02)1/6−1≈0.0033059
  3. n=300; PMT=1−(1+i)−nPV⋅i​n=300；PMT=1−(1+i)−nPV⋅i​
  4. TVM does steps 1–2 if P/Y =12, C/Y =2.在 TVM 里设 P/Y =12、C/Y =2，前两步自动完成。
Try试一试
Find the monthly payment on a $200000 mortgage at 4% compounded semi-annually, amortized over 25 years.$200000 房贷，年利率 4%、半年复利，25 年摊还，求每月还款。
Answer答案
≈$1052.04 per month (using r/12 would wrongly give $1055.67).每月约 $1052.04（错用 r/12 会得到 $1055.67）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资
  • i=0.069 for monthly payments ✗ → i=0.069/12, n in months.按月还款用 i=0.069 ✗ → i=0.069/12，n 按月计。
  • Total of payments = interest ✗ → subtract the amount borrowed.把还款总额当利息 ✗ → 要减去借款额。
🎯
TVM Solver: money out negative, money in positive; set P/Y and C/Y first (Canadian mortgage C/Y =2).TVM 求解器：付出为负、收到为正；先设好 P/Y 和 C/Y（加拿大房贷 C/Y =2）。

💰 Financial Literacy金融素养

Buy, lease or rent?买、租赁还是租用？

A lease at $389 a month looks far cheaper than a $703 car-loan payment. Add up everything over four years — including what the car is worth at the end — and buying can come out ahead.每月 $389 的租赁看上去比 $703 的车贷便宜得多。把四年的所有花费加起来——包括车到时还值多少钱——买车反而可能更划算。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 25 min

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Buy, lease or rent?买、租赁还是租用？
  1. Buy: net cost = total paid − value at the end. Lease: down + payments + end fees; you own nothing.买：净成本＝总支出 − 期末残值。租：首付＋月供＋到期费用；到期什么都不归你。
  2. Depreciation compounds: V=P(1−r)t; appreciation: V=P(1+r)t.贬值是复利式的：V=P(1−r)t；升值：V=P(1+r)t。
  3. Rent vs buy: compare unrecoverable costs; mortgage principal is equity, not a cost.租房还是买房：比较收不回的成本；房贷本金是自己的资产，不算成本。
V=P(1−r)t
V=P(1+r)t

🧗 The hard part难点 · Buy, lease or rent?买、租赁还是租用？

Net cost of buying vs total cost of leasing买车净成本 vs 租车总成本

Buying needs a subtraction (resale value) that leasing does not, so the two are not compared like-for-like.买要减去转卖价值而租不用，两边常常没有可比口径。

  1. Buy: total paid = down + PMT×n (or cash price)买：总支出 = 首付 + PMT×n（或现金价）
  2. Subtract resale: P(1−r)t减去转卖价值：P(1−r)t
  3. Lease: down + monthly ×n + end fees租：首付 + 月供 ×n + 到期费用
  4. Compare the two net costs比较两个净成本
Try试一试
Buy a $30000 car for cash (loses 20% a year, sold after 3 years), or lease: $2000 down, $399 a month for 36 months, $600 end fees?现金买一辆 $30000 的车（每年贬值 20%，3 年后卖掉），还是租：首付 $2000、每月 $399 共 36 个月、到期费用 $600？
Answer答案
Buy: 30000−30000(0.8)3=$14640. Lease: $16964. Buying is $2324 cheaper.买：30000−30000(0.8)3=$14640。租：$16964。买便宜 $2324。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Buy, lease or rent?买、租赁还是租用？
  • Taking 15% of the ORIGINAL price every year ✗ → 15% of that year’s value.每年都减原价的 15% ✗ → 每年减当年价值的 15%。
  • Comparing monthly payments only ✗ → compare total cost minus what you own at the end.只比月供 ✗ → 比总成本减去期末拥有的价值。
🎯
Make a two-column table (buy | lease) and end each column with one "net cost" line.列一张两栏表（买｜租），每栏最后一行写「净成本」。

quiz.q: A credit card charges 19.99% per year compounded daily. If $1200 sits unpaid for one year (no payments), what is owed?信用卡年利率 19.99%，按日复利。1200 加元一年不还（不付任何款），欠多少？
quiz.a: $1465.461465.46 加元
quiz.sol: • 1200(1+3650.1999​)365≈1465.46 — over $265 of interest in a year.1200(1+3650.1999​)365≈1465.46——一年利息超过 265 加元。
quiz.goal: Find the cost of credit-card interest compounded daily over a year.计算信用卡按日复利一年的欠款。

quiz.q: What annual rate, compounded annually, doubles money in exactly 8 years? Nearest hundredth of a percent.按年复利，年利率多少能让资金正好 8 年翻倍？精确到 0.01%。
quiz.a: 9.05%
quiz.sol: • r=21/8−1≈0.0905, i.e. 9.05%. (Rule of 72 estimate: 72÷8=9%.)r=21/8−1≈0.0905，即 9.05%。（72 法则估算：72÷8=9%。）
quiz.goal: Solve for the annual rate that doubles money in 8 years.求 8 年翻倍所需的年利率。
quiz.idea: (1+i)8=2, so i=21/8−1.(1+i)8=2，所以 i=21/8−1。

quiz.q: Find the effective annual rate of 6% compounded monthly, to the nearest hundredth of a percent.求年利率 6%、按月复利的实际年利率，精确到 0.01%。
quiz.a: 6.17%
quiz.sol: • (1.005)12≈1.061678, so the effective rate is about 6.17%.(1.005)12≈1.061678，实际年利率约 6.17%。
quiz.goal: Find the effective annual rate of a nominal rate compounded monthly.求按月复利的名义利率对应的有效年利率。
quiz.idea: Compare growth of 1 over a year: (1+0.06/12)12−1.看 1 元一年的增长：(1+0.06/12)12−1。

quiz.q: A BC family puts $4000 into a RESP when a child is born. It earns 4.5% per year compounded semi-annually for 18 years. Inflation averages 2.5% per year. (a) Find the amount at 18. (b) Find what that amount is worth in today's dollars by dividing by the inflation growth over 18 years. (c) Find the effective annual rate of the RESP and use it with inflation to find the real yearly growth rate; say what this means for the family.BC 一个家庭在孩子出生时往 RESP 存入 $4000，年利率 4.5%、每半年复利一次，存 18 年。通胀平均每年 2.5%。(a) 求 18 岁时的金额。(b) 把该金额除以 18 年通胀增长倍数，求相当于今天多少钱。(c) 求这个 RESP 的有效年利率，再结合通胀求真实年增长率，并说明这对家庭意味着什么。
quiz.a: (a) $8911.27; (b) ≈$5713.60 in today's dollars; (c) effective rate ≈4.55%, real growth ≈2.0% per year.(a) $8911.27；(b) 约合今天的 $5713.60；(c) 有效年利率约 4.55%，真实年增长率约 2.0%。
quiz.sol:
• A=4000(1.0225)36≈$8911.27.A=4000(1.0225)36≈$8911.27。
  • Today's dollars: 1.025188911.27​≈$5713.60.折算为今天的钱：1.025188911.27​≈$5713.60。
  • Effective rate =1.02252−1≈0.04551, about 4.55%. Real growth =1.0251.04551​−1≈0.0200, about 2.0% per year.有效年利率 =1.02252−1≈0.04551，约 4.55%。真实增长率 =1.0251.04551​−1≈0.0200，约每年 2.0%。
  • Meaning: the account looks like it more than doubles, but purchasing power grows only about 43%, since 5713.60/4000≈1.43. Tuition costs usually rise faster than inflation, so extra contributions matter.含义：账户看起来翻了一倍多，但购买力只增长约 43%（5713.60/4000≈1.43）。学费涨幅通常高于通胀，所以还需要追加存款。
quiz.goal: Combine compound growth, effective rate and inflation to judge the real value of a savings plan.综合复利增长、有效年利率和通胀，判断储蓄计划的真实价值。
quiz.idea: Nominal growth and inflation are both multipliers; dividing one by the other gives the real growth.名义增长和通胀都是乘数；相除即得真实增长。

quiz.q: A couple takes a $400000 mortgage at 5% per year compounded semi-annually, paid monthly. The bank offers a 25-year amortization or a 20-year amortization. (a) Find the monthly payment for each option. (b) Find the total interest for each and how much the 20-year option saves. (c) The extra monthly payment is how much? Decide which option you would recommend for a family whose budget can handle at most $2500 a month, and justify it.一对夫妇办理 $400000 房贷，年利率 5%、每半年复利一次、按月还款。银行提供 25 年或 20 年的摊还期。(a) 分别求两种方案的月供。(b) 分别求总利息，以及 20 年方案节省多少。(c) 月供多出多少？若这家人的预算每月最多负担 $2500，你会推荐哪个方案？说明理由。
quiz.a: (a) $2326.42 and $2628.50; (b) interest $297926 and $230840, saving about $67086; (c) $302.08 more per month; the 25-year option, since $2628.50>$2500.(a) $2326.42 与 $2628.50；(b) 利息 $297926 与 $230840，约节省 $67086；(c) 每月多 $302.08；推荐 25 年方案，因为 $2628.50>$2500。
quiz.sol:
• Monthly rate i=1.0251/6−1≈0.004124.月利率 i=1.0251/6−1≈0.004124。
  • 25 years: PMT=400000⋅1−(1+i)−300i​≈$2326.42. 20 years: n=240 gives ≈$2628.50.25 年：PMT=400000⋅1−(1+i)−300i​≈$2326.42。20 年：n=240，约 $2628.50。
  • Total interest: 2326.42×300−400000≈$297926; 2628.50×240−400000≈$230840. Saving ≈$67086.总利息：2326.42×300−400000≈$297926；2628.50×240−400000≈$230840。节省约 $67086。
  • Extra per month: 2628.50−2326.42=$302.08. Because 2628.50>2500, the 20-year payment exceeds the budget, so recommend 25 years, and if the budget grows, make extra payments to shorten the amortization.每月多付：2628.50−2326.42=$302.08。由于 2628.50>2500，20 年方案超出预算，所以推荐 25 年；预算宽裕后可以提前还款来缩短摊还期。
quiz.goal: Compare two amortization options by payment, total interest and affordability, and make a justified recommendation.从月供、总利息和可负担性比较两种摊还期，并作出有理由的推荐。
quiz.idea: Shorter amortization saves interest but raises the monthly payment; the budget is the binding constraint.摊还期越短，利息越省但月供越高；预算才是约束条件。

quiz.q: A $1800 laptop loses 30% of its value each year. What is it worth after 3 years?一台 $1800 的笔记本电脑每年贬值 30%。3 年后值多少？
quiz.a: $617.40
quiz.sol: • 1800(0.7)3=1800(0.343)=617.40.1800(0.7)3=1800(0.343)=617.40。
quiz.goal: Apply a depreciation model to a purchase.对一件购置品应用贬值模型。
quiz.idea: Losing 30% each year means multiplying by 0.70.每年损失 30% 即每年乘 0.70。

quiz.q: Which statement about a car lease is true?关于汽车租赁，下列哪项正确？
c: You own the car at the end.期末车归你所有。
There is no limit on kilometres.里程没有限制。
You return the car and own nothing at the end.期末还车，什么都不拥有。
Total cost is always lower than buying.总费用总是比购买低。
quiz.a: You return the car and own nothing at the end.到期还车，什么都不归你。
quiz.sol: • A lease is a long rental: the car goes back to the dealer, usually with a kilometre limit. Whether it is cheaper depends on the numbers.租赁就是长期租用：车要还给车行，通常有里程限制。是否更便宜要看具体数字。
quiz.goal: Know what a lease is and what you own at the end.知道租赁的含义，以及期末拥有什么。
quiz.idea: A lease pays for use, not ownership.租赁买的是使用权，不是所有权。

quiz.q: A house bought for $850000 appreciates 4% per year. What is it worth after 10 years? Nearest dollar.一套房子 $850000 买入，每年升值 4%。10 年后值多少？精确到元。
quiz.a: $1258208
quiz.sol: • 1.0410≈1.48024, so V≈1258208.1.0410≈1.48024，所以 V≈1258208。
quiz.goal: Find an appreciated value after many years.求多年后升值的价值。
quiz.idea: Multiply by 1.04 ten times: 850000(1.04)10.乘 1.04 十次：850000(1.04)10。

quiz.q: A 3-year lease: $2500 down, $429 a month, and $0.12 per km over the 60 000 km limit. You drive 66 000 km. Total cost?3 年租约：首付 $2500，每月 $429，超过 60 000 km 的部分每公里收 $0.12。你开了 66 000 km。总成本多少？
quiz.a: $18664
quiz.sol: • 2500+429×36+0.12×6000=2500+15444+720=18664.2500+429×36+0.12×6000=2500+15444+720=18664。
quiz.goal: Add up lease costs including a mileage penalty.加总租赁成本，包括超里程罚款。
quiz.idea: Penalty applies only to the 6000 km over the limit.罚款只针对超出限额的 6000 km。

quiz.q: A car depreciates 18% per year. After how many full years is it first worth less than half its price?一辆车每年贬值 18%。几整年后它的价值第一次低于原价的一半？
quiz.a: 4 years4 年
quiz.sol: • 0.823≈0.551 (still above half); 0.824≈0.452 (below half). So 4 years.0.823≈0.551（仍高于一半）；0.824≈0.452（低于一半）。所以是 4 年。
quiz.goal: Use an exponential depreciation model to find when value drops below half.用指数贬值模型求价值首次低于一半的时间。
quiz.idea: Find the first t with 0.82t<0.5.求使 0.82t<0.5 的最小整数 t。

quiz.q: You finance a $22000 car at 4.9% compounded monthly over 5 years. Find the monthly payment and the total interest.车价 $22000 全额贷款，年利率 4.9% 按月复利，5 年。求月供和总利息。
quiz.a: $414.16 per month; interest $2849.60月供 $414.16；利息 $2849.60
quiz.sol:
• PMT=1−(1+0.049/12)−6022000(0.049/12)​≈414.16.PMT=1−(1+0.049/12)−6022000(0.049/12)​≈414.16。
  • Interest =414.16×60−22000=2849.60.利息 =414.16×60−22000=2849.60。
quiz.goal: Find a car-loan payment and the total interest.求汽车贷款的月供和总利息。
quiz.idea: Use the payment formula, then total paid minus the price.用月供公式，再用总还款额减车价。

quiz.q: Rent is $2100 a month. Owning a similar home would cost, per year: mortgage interest $16000, property tax $2200, strata $4800, maintenance $1500, lost return on the down payment $3000. Which is cheaper this year, and by how much?月租 $2100。买类似的房子每年要付：房贷利息 $16000、地税 $2200、物业费 $4800、维修 $1500、首付的机会成本 $3000。今年哪个更便宜？便宜多少？
quiz.a: Renting, by $2300租房，便宜 $2300
quiz.sol:
• Rent: 2100×12=25200. Own: 16000+2200+4800+1500+3000=27500.租：2100×12=25200。买：16000+2200+4800+1500+3000=27500。
  • Renting is $2300 cheaper this year. Owning catches up only if the home gains more than $2300 in value during the year.今年租房便宜 $2300。只有房子这一年升值超过 $2300，买房才追得上。
quiz.goal: Decide between renting and owning from a list of yearly costs.根据一组年度成本，在租房与买房之间作决定。
quiz.idea: Add all owner costs that are not recovered; compare with 12 months of rent.加总业主所有不可回收的成本，与 12 个月房租比较。

quiz.q: A lease on a $36000 car costs $2000 down plus $419 a month for 36 months. At the end of the lease you may return the car, or buy it for the contract residual price of $21000. The car actually loses 17% of its value each year. (a) Find the cost of leasing and returning the car, and the monthly cost of that option. (b) Find the car's real market value after 3 years. (c) Should you exercise the buyout? Justify with numbers, and say what residual price would make the buyout fair.一辆 $36000 的车，租赁合同为首付 $2000，另每月 $419，共 36 个月。租期结束时可以还车，也可以按合同残值价 $21000 买下。这辆车实际每年贬值 17%。(a) 求租赁并还车的总成本和该方案的每月成本。(b) 求 3 年后这辆车的实际市场价值。(c) 你应该行使买断权吗？用数字说明，并说明残值定为多少才算公平。
quiz.a: (a) $17084, about $474.56 a month; (b) $20584.33; (c) No: the buyout is $415.67 above market; a fair residual is about $20584.(a) $17084，每月约 $474.56；(b) $20584.33；(c) 不应买断：残值价比市场价高 $415.67；公平的残值约 $20584。
quiz.sol:
• Lease and return: 2000+419×36=2000+15084=$17084. Per month: 3617084​≈$474.56.租赁并还车：2000+419×36=2000+15084=$17084。每月：3617084​≈$474.56。
  • Market value: 36000(0.83)3≈$20584.33.市场价值：36000(0.83)3≈$20584.33。
  • The residual is 21000−20584.33=$415.67 more than the car is worth, so buying it out overpays; you would pay more than you could get for it. A fair residual is the expected market value, about $20584.残值价比车的实际价值高 21000−20584.33=$415.67，买断就是多付钱，买下后也卖不出这个价。公平的残值应等于预期市场价，约 $20584。
  • Caveat: this uses a model; real resale prices depend on condition and mileage, so check the actual market before deciding.提醒：这里用的是模型；实际转售价取决于车况和里程，决定前要看真实的市场报价。
quiz.goal: Combine a lease cost, a depreciation model and a buyout price to make and justify a decision.综合租赁成本、贬值模型和买断价，作出并论证一个决定。
quiz.idea: Compare the contract price with the modelled market value, not with the price of a new car.要拿合同价与模型算出的市场价比较，而不是和新车价比。

diag.q: $3000 is invested at 6% per year compounded quarterly for 5 years. Find the amount.$3000 以年利率 6%、按季复利投资 5 年，求本利和。
c: $3231.85
$9621.41
$4040.57
$3900.00
why: Used t=5 as the exponent instead of nt=20.指数用了 t=5，应为 nt=20。
Used 0.06 per quarter — forgot to divide the annual rate by 4.每季用了 0.06——忘了把年利率除以 4。
Correct: 3000(1.015)20≈$4040.57.正确：3000(1.015)20≈$4040.57。
Used simple interest 3000(1+0.06⋅5); compound interest earns interest on interest.用了单利 3000(1+0.06⋅5)；复利是利滚利。
diag.goal: Apply the compound interest formula with the right i and n.用正确的每期利率和期数套复利公式。
diag.idea: i=0.06/4=0.015, periods =4⋅5=20.i=0.06/4=0.015，期数 =4⋅5=20。

diag.q: On $10000 for 3 years: A pays 5.0% compounded annually; B pays 4.9% compounded monthly. Which gives more, and by how much?本金 $10000 存 3 年：A 年利率 5.0%、按年复利；B 年利率 4.9%、按月复利。哪个更多？多多少？
c: A, $1453.25
B, $3.82
A, $10.00
B, $44388.89
why: For B used exponent 3 instead of 12⋅3=36.B 的指数用了 3，应为 12⋅3=36。
Correct: A =10000(1.05)3=$11576.25, B =10000(1+120.049​)36≈$11580.07.正确：A =10000(1.05)3=$11576.25，B =10000(1+120.049​)36≈$11580.07。
Assumed the higher rate wins and took the 0.1% gap on $10000; more frequent compounding can beat a slightly higher rate — compute both.以为利率高的一定赢，直接拿 0.1% 的差乘本金；复利更频繁可能胜过稍高的利率——两边都要算。
For B used 0.049 per month (forgot ÷12).B 每月用了 0.049（忘了 ÷12）。
diag.goal: Compare offers with different rates and compounding frequencies.比较利率和计息频率都不同的两种方案。
diag.idea: Compute both final amounts, then subtract.两个终值都算出来，再相减。

diag.q: A $12000 loan at 6% compounded monthly is repaid monthly over 4 years. Find the payment.$12000 贷款，年利率 6%、按月复利，4 年按月还清，求每月还款。
c: $281.82
$3037.59
$766.77
$250.00
why: Correct: i=0.005, n=48: 1−1.005−4812000(0.005)​≈$281.82.正确：i=0.005，n=48：1−1.005−4812000(0.005)​≈$281.82。
Used n=4 (years) instead of 48 payments.用了 n=4（年数），应为 48 次还款。
Used the annual rate 0.06 as i per month.把年利率 0.06 当成每月利率。
Divided 12000 by 48 and ignored interest.直接用 12000÷48，忽略了利息。
diag.goal: Find a loan payment with the correct i and n.用正确的 i 和 n 求贷款每期还款。
diag.idea: i=0.06/12, n=12⋅4.i=0.06/12，n=12⋅4。

diag.q: You deposit $150 at the end of every month for 8 years at 4.8% compounded monthly. How much of the final amount is interest?每月月底存 $150，存 8 年，年利率 4.8%、按月复利。最终金额中利息有多少？
c: $17513.30
$5529.60
$3113.30
$6725.11
why: That is the future value; interest is FV minus the $14400 deposited.这是终值；利息＝终值减去存入的 $14400。
Simple interest on all deposits for the full 8 years; most deposits earn for far less time.把全部存款按单利算满 8 年；大部分存款存的时间短得多。
Correct: FV=150⋅0.0041.00496−1​≈$17513.30; minus $14400.正确：FV=150⋅0.0041.00496−1​≈$17513.30；减去 $14400。
Treated all $14400 as deposited on day one (lump sum); an annuity is paid in over time.把 $14400 当成第一天一次存入；年金是分期存入的。
diag.goal: Find the interest earned in a savings annuity.求储蓄年金中赚到的利息。
diag.idea: Find FV with i=0.004, n=96, then subtract total deposits.用 i=0.004、n=96 求终值，再减总存入。

diag.q: A $28000 car depreciates 20% per year. What is it worth after 3 years?一辆 $28000 的车每年贬值 20%，3 年后值多少？
c: $11200
$14336
$224
$48384
why: Took 20% of the original price each year (straight-line); depreciation compounds.每年都减原价的 20%（直线法）；贬值是复利式的。
Correct: 28000(0.8)3=$14336.正确：28000(0.8)3=$14336。
Used r instead of 1−r as the factor: (0.2)3.用 r 而不是 1−r 当因子：(0.2)3。
Used 1+r: that is appreciation, not depreciation.用了 1+r：那是升值，不是贬值。
diag.goal: Compute a depreciated value with the compound model.用复利模型计算贬值后的价值。
diag.idea: Each year keeps 80%: multiply by 0.8 three times.每年保留 80%：连乘三次 0.8。

diag.q: Rent is $2200 a month. Owning a similar home costs, this year: mortgage payments $27000 (of which $17000 is interest), property tax $2500, strata $4200, maintenance $1800, lost return on the down payment $3500. Which is cheaper in unrecoverable costs, and by how much?租金每月 $2200。买一套类似的房子今年的支出：房贷还款 $27000（其中利息 $17000），地税 $2500，物业费 $4200，维修 $1800，首付损失的投资收益 $3500。按收不回的成本算，哪个更便宜？便宜多少？
c: Rent, $12600租，$12600
Own, $900买，$900
Own, $9400买，$9400
Rent, $2600租，$2600
why: Counted the whole mortgage payment; the $10000 principal becomes equity.把整笔房贷还款都算成本；其中 $10000 本金变成了房产权益。
Ignored the lost return on the down payment — that money could have been earning.忽略了首付的机会成本——那笔钱本可以赚收益。
Compared rent with mortgage interest only and ignored the other owner costs.只拿租金和房贷利息比，漏了业主的其他成本。
Correct: own =17000+2500+4200+1800+3500=$29000; rent =$26400.正确：买 =17000+2500+4200+1800+3500=$29000；租 =$26400。
diag.goal: Compare renting and owning by unrecoverable costs.用收不回的成本比较租房与买房。
diag.idea: Only interest, tax, strata, maintenance and lost return are lost; principal is not.只有利息、地税、物业费、维修和机会成本是损失；本金不是。
